lines: [sly] [fake friendly] Hi! You were overcharged. I'm refunding you two hundred dollars!
[fast] Oops! My finger slipped! I sent you two THOUSAND! Send back eighteen hundred in gift cards, please!
[whispering] Psst. Open your real bank app.
[reading] My bank app says... zero new dollars.
[innocent] Okay! I'll send it back the same way you sent it.
[cheerful] Refunds go back to the card they came from! So... what's YOUR card number?
[warmly] A real refund never comes with 'send the extra back.' Check your bank app yourself. Never the screen they show you.
